description: Internal header for Linux kernel cryptographic API, defining structures, inline functions, and external references related to cryptographic algorithms and notifications.

methods.name: crypto_cipher_ctxsize
methods.description: Inline function returning context size for cipher algorithms.

methods.name: crypto_compress_ctxsize
methods.description: Inline function returning context size for compression algorithms.

methods.name: crypto_tmpl_get
methods.description: Increases module reference count for a crypto template.

methods.name: crypto_tmpl_put
methods.description: Decreases module reference count for a crypto template.

methods.name: crypto_is_larval
methods.description: Checks if a crypto algorithm is in larval state.

methods.name: crypto_is_dead
methods.description: Checks if a crypto algorithm is marked as dead.

methods.name: crypto_is_moribund
methods.description: Checks if a crypto algorithm is in dying or dead state.

methods.name: crypto_notify
methods.description: Calls the crypto notification chain with given event.
